verdicts.reason: Both separate the flavour names (in reversed order) from their descriptors, enlarge one bag to hero size and shrink the other two to thumbnails beside a tiny 'Build Your Pack' button. A keeps the headline on one strong line but its body copy is one illegible line. B's body copy is a little more readable, but its headline wraps and leaves 'light' alone on the second line, which hurts the main message more.

A's CTA is a tiny pill at the bottom left with thumbnail bags beside it, the body copy is microscopic and the flavour and descriptor lists are mismatched. B makes the CTA large and readable, but puts it in the top-right corner above the headline, which breaks reading order. Its body copy is even smaller and the two thumbnail bags float alone at the bottom. B is slightly better only because its CTA can be read.

The layouts are nearly the same. A pushes the tiny CTA almost against the left canvas edge and the bag close to the right edge, and its body copy is one microscopic line. B has slightly better margins, but has the same tiny CTA, illegible body copy, thumbnail bags and mismatched flavour and descriptor lists.

A's headline wraps and leaves 'light' alone on the second line. It also has a tiny CTA with thumbnail bags at the bottom right, and its flavour lists are reversed and detached from their descriptions. B keeps the headline on one prominent line, but runs it almost into the right edge. Its body copy is a single illegible line and its CTA is still tiny, so B is only marginally better.
